Body.Content:
Updated July 14, 2026: The July 2026 Scan Cab is now available as of 2:00 PM PDT.

Note: This notice only affects environments where Scan Cab is used to check for Microsoft update compliance.

What and why:
The Scan Cab for the July 2026 Microsoft security updates is currently delayed and has not yet been released.

Rollout schedule:
We estimate it will be released later today, and we will communicate an update as more information becomes available. Thank you for your patience.

Who is affected:
IT administrators who rely on Scan Cab to check for update compliance can monitor our communications for updates.

What will happen:
Updates on the availability of this month's Scan Cab will be communicated as new information becomes available.
 
Additional information:
  • Learn more about the Scan Cab process: Announcing a smaller WSUS Scan Cab
  • Use Windows Update Agent (WUA) to scan computers for security updates without connecting to Windows Update: Using WUA to Scan for Updates Offline - Win32 apps
  • Documentation on the Catalog Site used to import updates and drivers: WSUS and the Catalog Site

message.Title: Notice: The July 2026 Scan Cab for Microsoft updates is delayed
